svg.title: Raft / DWC aquaponics — Fish treatment & raft return
svg.desc: Fish treatment & raft return. 8 equipment references and 10 declared directed connections. Static illustrative symbols; arrows do not show instantaneous flow. This selected view does not include every plant connection.
